en: Vintage sepia postcard with two framed photographs bordered by decorative grapevine illustrations. The left photo shows the exterior of a corner building with the sign "Zum wilden Mann" above the entrance, on a cobblestone street. The right photo shows the interior of a grand dining room with long tables, many chairs, ornate wall decorations, chandeliers, and a large mirror. Printed text at the bottom identifies the location as Uerdingen on the Rhine and the establishment as Hôtel-Restaurant "Zum wilden Mann".
